definitions.explanation: A place of historical significance that is well known for its beauty, importance, or cultural value.

definitions.gloss: distinguished family name; prestigious stage name lineage
definitions.explanation: A hereditary name or title, especially in traditional arts, that carries prestige and is passed down through generations.

examples.english: Kyoto has many famous historic sites.

examples.english: I set out on a journey to visit famous historic sites.

examples.english: There is a responsibility to protect a prestigious family name with a long history.

notes:
Has two distinct meanings depending on context and sometimes reading.

Sense 1: {名|めい} (famous) + {跡|せき} (ruins, traces). Famous historical sites or ruins. Read as めいせき.

Sense 2: {名|めい} (name) + {跡|せき} (succession, legacy). A hereditary name or title, especially in kabuki and other traditional performing arts. Often read as みょうせき in this sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名跡|めいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: visit a famous historic site
- {名跡|めいせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧: tour famous historic sites
- {名跡|みょうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧: succeed to a prestigious name
- {名跡|みょうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{襲名|しゅうめい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: formally assume a hereditary name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{史跡|しせき}→史跡：11952_shiseki⟧: historic site — an officially designated historical place
- ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧: famous place, scenic spot — broader term including natural beauty, not limited to ruins
- {旧跡|きゅうせき}: historic ruins — emphasizes age and remnants of the past
